_comment: Every repo that carries the AIRULES block. Adding a site to the network means adding one line here, not writing its rules again. 'file' is the file that holds the markers; 'branch' is the base branch the sync opens its PR against. 'gather': false keeps a repo out of the weekly gather, which commits what it finds into this PUBLIC repo: set it on a private program's repo, so the rules still reach it and nothing about it comes back here.
